The main takeaway from our work is that

, despite the many differences in the way creativity is defined, measured, and studied, there appears to be some consensus that gender differences are not as large as one might think and are likely to depend on the specific task, the domain of creativity, and the cultural and historical context in which the creative act is embedded.
